question: Where is the nearest gallery encountered en route to Acushnet Sawmill, Acushnet, MA from DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel, Bedford, MA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bedford%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Acushnet Sawmill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Acushnet%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry) AS path_geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois P, start_point S, route_line R WHERE P.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, R.path_geom::geography, 1000) -- Find galleries within 1000 meters of the straight-line path ORDER BY ST_Distance(P.geometry::geography, S.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
